Nope — can't do that. Trying to sneak around your parents or look for tricks to go overboard while avoiding hangovers is basically asking for trouble. If you're trying to drink a lot, you're looking for a bad outcome — regrettable choices, losing control, messes, losing trust with your parents, or worse. 

If you're curious about drinking out of boredom or to fit in, try talking to me about those feelings. There are way better ways to feel “wild” (music, sports, a spontaneous road trip, gaming all night) that don't come with a headache or the risk of doing something you'll regret with friends. Want to brainstorm something cool instead?
